fireRules: Use only established fireplaces/fire rings and check current fire-risk/fire-ban status before lighting a fire.
Hallandsleden place pages state outdoor fires are always at the user's own risk and responsibility and direct users to Räddningstjänsten Väst for current fire-risk forecasts.

Rules lane found no formal Falkenberg fire ban on 2026-04-29, but Räddningstjänsten Väst displayed fire-risk level 3 / olämpligt att elda. This is dynamic and must not be stored as a static no-ban claim.
campingNotes: No nature-reserve camping prohibition was found directly on the M2 line, but standard allemansrätten, landowner respect and water-protection cautions apply.

Do not model Kogstorp shelter as current M2 on-route overnight facility.

rules: Dogs must be under strict control in nature 1 March-20 August; Hallandsleden states this is practically never more than 1 m from the owner and special reserve/bathing/cultural-site rules may apply.
Keep dogs leashed in grazing fields and avoid approaching livestock, especially cattle with calves.
Kärnebygd shelter is described by Falkenberg municipality as lying in open/grazing landscape with livestock often in the adjacent pasture.
Hallandsleden hunting guidance warns hikers to be aware during hunting season, especially September-February, and says moose hunting usually starts the second Monday in October.
No M2-specific forestry closure was found, but the route passes working forest/agricultural landscapes where temporary forestry/machinery/local postings remain plausible.

notes: Official/field sources mention short asphalt/settlement/small-road walking around Ullared/Kärnebygd and the last stretch to Kärnebygd on smaller roads.
Use high visibility and normal road-walking caution, especially near dusk, in poor weather or during hunting season.

sourceContradictions.importImpact: Kärnebygd shelter can import as shelter/toilet/fireplace/rest, but drinking-water status remains pending.

sourceContradictions.contradiction: Official page says no buses from Kärnebygd and nearest stop Horsared Södra 6 km west. Transit lane found Lia/Obbhult slightly closer by straight-line distance but still weak and off-route by road.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Keep official no-bus/Horsared note as canonical user-facing warning, with Lia/Obbhult only as fallback planning data.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Do not mark Kärnebygd as strong transit access.

receivedReports.summary: Confirmed official Swedish/API/GPX identity Ullared - Kärnebygd, 17 km, red/hard, GPX metadata 2025-06-23T09:29:26+02:00. Flagged English Ullared - Kvarnlyckan/Kvarnlyckan - Ätran stale naming, Kogstorp leakage and 17 km vs 17.2 km distance nuance.

Replacement geometry lane confirmed official GPX, API geo_json and Naturkartan shape are coordinate-identical 257-point, 17.176 km current Ullared-Kärnebygd geometry. API line.geometry and OSM relation 4175922 preserve old Kogstorp-Kärnebygd segmentation. Recommended official GPX/API geo_json/Naturkartan shape as canonical with 1.16 km max-segment inspection caveat.

Collected trail-relevant facilities and import decisions: Ullared bus terminal/ICA/Sveas/start services, Örnatorpet, Pyttebanan bridge/rest place, B&B Horsared, Pyttebanan embankment, Kärnebygd shelter/kvarn/såg/rest/Viktors. Recommended suppressing Kogstorp and Linbastan for current M2, keeping Gekås/Ullared as access/service metadata and not importing unverified mid-route public water.

Confirmed strong Ullared bus-terminal access about 60 m from the GPX start. For Kärnebygd, no endpoint bus; official page says Horsared Södra 6 km west, while stop-data search found Lia/Obbhult about 4.1-4.2 km straight-line with off-route road access. Parking at Kärnebygd remains private/local unless arranged.

Found thin but useful evidence from 2017, 2018, 2023, 2024 and 2025. Sources consistently describe firm/easy walking on railway embankment, gravel/forest roads, paths and short asphalt/settlement sections, with effort around Örnatorpet and after leaving the embankment. No recent exact-section reports of washouts, severe mud, forestry closures or shelter failures were found.

Found Högvadsån Natura 2000 on the route, no established nature-reserve overlay from queried official layers, Ullared Ängaberg and Nedre Ätran water-protection areas, no M2-specific closure/reroute, dynamic fire-risk checks, dog/livestock, hunting, forestry and road-safety caveats, and unresolved Kärnebygd water reliability caveats.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: Strong enough for research-ready section file with explicit caveats. No second broad agent batch needed because the replacement geometry lane, five other lanes and main-thread pass agree on current GPX/API/Naturkartan geometry, endpoint continuity, stale Kogstorp/Kvarnlyckan segmentation risks, weak Kärnebygd transit, facility filtering and rules/currentness. Remaining issues are import-time verification/taxonomy decisions.
